gaps.sentence: The ___ (DIFFICULT) terrain slowed the rescue team.
gaps.explanation: 'Difficult terrain' — adjective needed; 'difficulty' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: There were three ___ (BURGLE) on our street last month.
gaps.explanation: 'Three burglaries' — plural noun for the crime; burglars are people.

gaps.sentence: He gave me some very useful ___ (ADVISE).
gaps.explanation: 'Advice' is uncountable — never 'advices'; 'advise' is the verb.

gaps.sentence: The journal gave full ___ (COVER) to the election.
gaps.explanation: 'Media coverage' — the noun for how much something is reported.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (ARRIVE) of the Queen caused a stir.
